title: Bat-borne zoonoses: transmission, impact, prevention, and management.
abstract: Abstract Climate change and biodiversity loss are global environmental crises driving emerging infectious diseases, including bat-borne pathogens of public health significance: Ebola, Marburg, Nipah, Hendra, classic rabies virus, and Australian bat lyssavirus, as well as the fungus Histoplasma . This review presents the evidence on the mechanisms of transmission, impact, and prevention and management strategies relevant to each of these pathogens. Transmission pathways vary between pathogens but often involve exposure to body fluids or excreta of a bat or other infected animal or human. The diseases associated with these infections have high mortality rates, and survivors may continue to experience a range of long term effects, including neurological and neuropsychiatric signs and symptoms. Prevention strategies may be implemented to reduce the risk of zoonotic spillover and human-to-human transmission of these pathogens, including better ecological stewardship, reducing exposure of domestic animals and humans to bats, isolation of infected people, and, where possible, vaccination of humans and animals. The mainstay of treatment for these conditions is supportive care; however, specific drugs are now available for histoplasmosis and Ebolavirus infection. In the face of climate change and further loss of biodiversity, developing more effective strategies to prevent and manage these conditions will be critical.

abstract_zh: 摘要 气候变化和生物多样性丧失是推动新发传染病的全球环境危机,包括对公共卫生有重要意义的蝙蝠源性病原体:埃博拉病毒、马尔堡病毒、尼帕病毒、亨德拉病毒、经典 狂犬病病毒 以及澳大利亚蝙蝠狂犬病病毒,还有真菌组织胞浆菌。本综述提供了关于 传播 机制、影响以及针对这些病原体的预防和管理策略的证据。不同病原体的 传播 传播途径有所不同,但通常涉及与蝙蝠或其他受感染动物或人类体液或排泄物的接触。这些感染所导致的疾病具有高 死亡率 发病率,幸存者可能会持续经历一系列长期影响,包括神经和神经精神症状和体征。可以通过实施预防策略来降低这些病原体的人兽共患病 跨物种溢出 和人际传播 传播 的风险,包括更好的生态管理、减少家畜和人类与蝙蝠的接触、隔离感染者,以及在可能的情况下对人类和动物进行 疫苗接种。这些疾病的 治疗 主要是支持性治疗;然而,现在已有针对组织胞浆菌病和埃博拉病毒感染的特定药物。在面对气候变化和进一步的生物多样性丧失时,开发更有效的预防和管理策略将是关键。

title: Lateral flow devices can fast-track rabies virus genomic surveillance
abstract: Viral genomic data can resolve rabies transmission and guide outbreak response, but surveillance is often limited less by sequencing capacity than by getting suitable specimens from remote collection sites to a laboratory, a process that can take months. Here, we show that lateral flow devices (LFDs) used for rabies diagnosis can also serve as genomic specimens, integrating diagnosis and genomic sampling into a single workflow without additional specimen collection. We evaluated LFDs and FTA cards for rabies virus genome recovery under laboratory and field conditions. During surveillance across the island provinces of MIMAROPA, Philippines, the Bionote LFD had 99.1% sensitivity and 100% specificity against the gold-standard direct fluorescent antibody test (n = 319), with results available a median of 1 day after sampling versus 5 days for DFAT confirmation. Under laboratory conditions simulating field storage (ambient temperature or 37 degrees Celsius for up to 21 days), both residual LFD material and FTA cards supported near-complete genome sequencing, although genome recovery declined with storage duration, particularly at elevated temperatures. Consistent with this, field-collected LFDs yielded near-complete genomes up to 23 days of ambient storage but only partial genomes after 29-77 days, indicating a practical window of around three weeks for use. Repurposing LFDs already embedded in diagnostic workflows offers a practical route to decentralised genomic surveillance without additional sample collection or a cold chain. FTA cards provide a complementary preservation option, while further optimisation of specimen preparation, extraction and storage could improve genome recovery and extend the sequencing window.

abstract_zh: 病毒基因组数据可以解决狂犬病 传播并指导暴发响应,但监测通常受限于从偏远采集点获取合适样本到实验室的物流挑战,而非测序能力,这一过程可能需要数月。在这里,我们展示了侧流装置(LFDs)用于狂犬病 诊断时,也可以作为基因组样本使用,将诊断和基因组采样整合到单一工作流程中,无需额外样本采集。我们评估了LFDs和FTA卡片在实验室和现场条件下对狂犬病病毒 基因组的回收效果。在菲律宾MIMAROPA群岛的监测期间,Bionote LFD对金标准直接荧光抗体检测(n = 319)的敏感度为99.1%,特异度为100%,采样后1天内即可获得结果,而DFAT确认需要5天。在模拟现场储存条件的实验室条件下(常温或37摄氏度储存最多21天),残留的LFD材料和FTA卡片均支持近乎完整的基因组测序,尽管储存时间越长,基因组回收率下降,尤其是在高温条件下。与此一致的是,现场采集的LFD在常温储存23天内可获得近乎完整的基因组,但在29-77天后仅能获得部分基因组,表明其实际使用窗口约为三周。将已嵌入诊断流程中的LFD重新利用,可以实现无需额外样本采集或冷链的去中心化基因组监测。FTA卡片提供了互补的保存选项,而进一步优化样本制备、提取和储存方法,可以提高基因组的回收率并延长测序窗口。

title: Integrating human rabies vaccines into routine immunization services in Tanzania: A participatory systems mapping study
abstract: Abstract Study aim : Human rabies is 100% preventable with post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) administered immediately after exposure to a rabid animal. In low-income countries, access to PEP is hampered by challenges, including frequent vaccine stockouts, limited facilities providing PEP, weak referral systems with inadequate involvement of animal health workers, and unaffordable costs to bite victims. The WHO and Gavi recommends integrating PEP into routine immunization services to improve access; however, the integration process has yet to be operationalized. We aimed to understand how interest-holders in Tanzania view the feasibility of integrating PEP into routine immunization services. Methods: We employed a participatory, systems-thinking, process mapping approach to examine the expectations of interest-holders on feasibility of integrating PEP into routine immunization services in Tanzania. We (i) undertook a desk review and expert consultation ( n = 15) to map interest-holders from local to national levels across both services; (ii) conducted in-depth interviews with national-level actors ( n = 6) and implementers ( n = 22) from involved sectors and with community members ( n = 4); (iii) analyzed resulting data using content analysis and mapped out processes for provision of PEP and routine immunization services; and (iv) organized a 2-day multisectoral co-creation workshop with interest-holders to refine and validate these maps. Finally, we assessed expectations of this integrated design using a consolidated framework we developed from three WHO guides on integrating immunization services. Main findings: Our process mapping approach revealed uncertainty and differing interpretations among interest-holders regarding the meaning of integration of PEP into routine immunization services. However, our facilitated workshop supported engaged dialogue that led to a consensus. Interest-holders considered integration to be feasible, given adequate support among health decision makers, infrastructure (vaccine management systems) and human resource skills. However, interest-holders also articulated anticipated barriers to integration, including (i) potential vaccine waste due to the lack of a resourced and operationalized One Health system for rabies risk assessments; (ii) high staff turnover that could precipitate substandard service provision; (iii) an absence of linked data systems for rabies cases and PEP utilization to inform demand forecasts; and (iv) routine immunization units working only limited days and hours, requiring staff redeployment and workflow redesign for emergency PEP provision. Principal Conclusions: Our results demonstrated enthusiasm for integrating PEP provision into routine immunization services in Tanzania to improve access to PEP through an operationalized One Health approach. Our co-creation process enhanced the possibility of integration by facilitating multisectoral problem identification and problem solving to address intervention uncertainties and complexities. We identified an important need to develop and employ integration guidance, protocols and roadmaps to systematically and comprehensively ensure readiness of the routine immunization systems to accommodate PEP provision. One Health impact statement Human rabies transmitted from domestic dogs is virtually 100% preventable with timely vaccination following exposure, yet access in Tanzania and similar settings is limited by vaccine availability, few facilities, weak referral systems, and high costs. WHO recommends integrating rabies post-exposure vaccine provisioning into routine immunization services, but how to do this remains unclear.Using participatory systems-thinking (process mapping), we brought together animal, human and environmental health sectors, and local government interest-holders, including community members, to analyse current post-exposure vaccine and routine immunization systems. Initially divergent understandings of “integration” gave way to consensus through facilitated co-production. Participants considered integration feasible, but identified multiple One Health challenges including a lack of: procedures for risk assessments, integrated information systems, as well as operational service differences. Sustained multisectoral, participatory engagement, together with integration guidance and roadmaps was identified as being essential to realize improved integrated services.

In low-income countries, access to PEP is hampered by challenges, including frequent vaccine stockouts, limited facilities providing PEP, weak referral systems with inadequate involvement of animal health workers, and unaffordable costs to bite victims. The WHO and Gavi recommends integrating PEP into routine immunization services to improve access; however, the integration process has yet to be operationalized. We aimed to understand how interest-holders in Tanzania view the feasibility of integrating PEP into routine immunization services. Methods: We employed a participatory, systems-thinking, process mapping approach to examine the expectations of interest-holders on feasibility of integrating PEP into routine immunization services in Tanzania. We (i) undertook a desk review and expert consultation ( n = 15) to map interest-holders from local to national levels across both services; (ii) conducted in-depth interviews with national-level actors ( n = 6) and implementers ( n = 22) from involved sectors and with community members ( n = 4); (iii) analyzed resulting data using content analysis and mapped out processes for provision of PEP and routine immunization services; and (iv) organized a 2-day multisectoral co-creation workshop with interest-holders to refine and validate these maps. Finally, we assessed expectations of this integrated design using a consolidated framework we developed from three WHO guides on integrating immunization services. Main findings: Our process mapping approach revealed uncertainty and differing interpretations among interest-holders regarding the meaning of integration of PEP into routine immunization services. However, our facilitated workshop supported engaged dialogue that led to a consensus. Interest-holders considered integration to be feasible, given adequate support among health decision makers, infrastructure (vaccine management systems) and human resource skills. However, interest-holders also articulated anticipated barriers to integration, including (i) potential vaccine waste due to the lack of a resourced and operationalized One Health system for rabies risk assessments; (ii) high staff turnover that could precipitate substandard service provision; (iii) an absence of linked data systems for rabies cases and PEP utilization to inform demand forecasts; and (iv) routine immunization units working only limited days and hours, requiring staff redeployment and workflow redesign for emergency PEP provision. Principal Conclusions: Our results demonstrated enthusiasm for integrating PEP provision into routine immunization services in Tanzania to improve access to PEP through an operationalized One Health approach. title: Rabies and rabies prophylaxis in Egypt: a nationwide cross-sectional study that calls for action
abstract: BACKGROUND: Rabies is a fatal but preventable viral disease that poses a global health threat, especially in developing countries. Despite the high incidence of animal bites reported annually in Egypt, limited data exist regarding the knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) of the general population toward rabies and rabies prophylaxis. METHODS: We conducted a nationwide cross-sectional study using a structured interview-based survey targeting individuals aged 18 years or older who attended outpatient clinics at nine university hospitals across Egypt. The survey assessed participants' KAP toward rabies and rabies prophylaxis and identified barriers to prophylaxis uptake. RESULTS: Among 1,777 participants who responded to the survey, only 42.8% (n = 760) had good knowledge about rabies and rabies prophylaxis, while the majority, 88.5% (n = 1,572), exhibited a positive attitude toward rabies prophylaxis. Knowledge was higher among those who reported awareness of rabies campaigns in their geographic areas (69.1% vs. 40.5%, p < 0.001) and those who had previously been bitten or attacked by animals (56.1% vs. Overall, 9.7% (n = 173) of participants reported a history of animal bites or attacks; however, 18.5% (n = 32) of these participants did not receive post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), and 17% (n = 24) did not complete the vaccine schedule. Pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) uptake was low, with only 4.3% (n = 23) of high-risk individuals receiving it. Key barriers to rabies prophylaxis included lack of knowledge about the rabies vaccine, reported by 82.4% of participants, lack of knowledge about rabies, reported by 81.7%, and inadequate hospital facilities, reported by 43.1%. CONCLUSIONS: Despite a generally positive attitude toward rabies prophylaxis, knowledge and adherence to prophylactic measures, including pre-exposure and post-exposure prophylaxis, remain relatively inadequate in Egypt. Public health interventions, such as educational campaigns and improved accessibility to vaccination services, are needed to address these gaps and mitigate the public health burden of rabies.

title: Pasture area increases livestock rabies risk in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil: a geospatial analysis of neurological syndrome cases (2020–2024)
abstract: Abstract Animal rabies poses a risk to livestock in Brazil due to transmission by hematophagous bats. The Brazilian sanitary surveillance system mandates rabies testing for any livestock exhibiting signs of neurological syndrome. This geospatial, retrospective, longitudinal, observational study analyzed rabies test results for 204 cattle and 56 horses presenting with neurological syndrome in Rio de Janeiro State, Brazil, from 2020 to 2024. We calculated correlations and linear models between rabies results and municipal land-use types, as well the population of herbivores. Most neurological syndrome cases and positive rabies results occurred in cattle. The final linear model for the number of neurological syndrome cases and positive rabies results incorporated pasture area, shrub area and cattle population. Pasture area was positively correlated with higher numbers ( p = 0.011 and p = 0.005, respectively). Larger shrub area was associated with fewer neurological syndrome reports and fewer positive results ( p = 0.009 and p = 0.010, respectively). Greater cattle population showed a negative association with neurological syndrome notifications and positive detections ( p = 0.085 and p = 0.046, respectively).A higher proportion of positive rabies tests was associated with larger pasture areas ( p = 0.019) and with lower equine populations ( p = 0.115). These findings indicate that the lower animal diversity in pasture areas provides few alternative feeding options for Desmodus rotundus besides livestock, leading to more neurological syndrome cases and animal rabies infections. A larger shrub area offer feed alternatives other than cattle to the bats and a larger cattle population dilutes the frequency of bat meals across individuals, reducing both neurological syndrome notifications and positive rabies detections.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the relationship between rabies risk in livestock and land-use patterns in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, from 2020 to 2024, as rabies transmission by hematophagous bats poses a significant threat to livestock.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A geospatial, retrospective, longitudinal, observational study analyzed rabies test results for 204 cattle and 56 horses presenting with neurological syndrome in Rio de Janeiro State, Brazil, from 2020 to 2024.
analysis.methods: The study calculated correlations and linear models between rabies results and municipal land-use types, as well as the population of herbivores.
analysis.main_results: Most neurological syndrome cases and positive rabies results occurred in cattle. Larger shrub area was associated with fewer neurological syndrome reports and fewer positive results (p = 0.009 and p = 0.010, respectively). Greater cattle population showed a negative association with neurological syndrome notifications and positive detections (p = 0.085 and p = 0.046, respectively). A higher proportion of positive rabies tests was associated with larger pasture areas (p = 0.019) and with lower equine populations (p = 0.115).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that pasture areas increase rabies risk in livestock due to the limited alternative feeding options for Desmodus rotundus, leading to more neurological syndrome cases and infections.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results can inform targeted surveillance and management strategies in regions with high pasture areas to mitigate rabies transmission risks to livestock.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is observational and retrospective, which may introduce bias and limit causal inference. The evidence is moderate due to the reliance on existing data and the absence of controlled experiments.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the relationship between rabies risk in livestock and land-use patterns in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, from 2020 to 2024. It analyzed rabies test results for 204 cattle and 56 horses presenting with neurological syndrome, finding that pasture areas were positively correlated with higher numbers of cases and positive detections. In contrast, shrub areas were associated with fewer cases and positive results. The study suggests that pasture areas increase rabies risk in livestock due to limited alternative feeding options for hematophagous bats. These findings can inform targeted surveillance and management strategies in regions with high pasture areas. However, the study is observational and retrospective, which may introduce bias and limit causal inference, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨2020年至2024年间巴西里约热内卢州牲畜狂犬病风险与土地利用模式之间的关系,因为血食性蝙蝠传播的传播对牲畜构成重大威胁。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项地理空间、回顾性、纵向、观察性研究分析了2020年至2024年间巴西里约热内卢州204头牛和56匹马的神经综合征病例的狂犬病检测结果。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究计算了狂犬病检测结果与市政土地利用类型以及草食动物种群数量之间的相关性和线性模型。
elements_zh.main_results: 大多数神经综合征病例和阳性狂犬病检测结果出现在牛中。更大的灌木面积与较少的神经综合征报告和较少的阳性结果相关(p = 0.009和p = 0.010)。更大的牛种群数量与神经综合征通知和阳性检测呈负相关(p = 0.085和p = 0.046)。更高的阳性狂犬病检测比例与更大的牧场面积(p = 0.019)和较低的马种群数量(p = 0.115)相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,牧场面积增加了牲畜狂犬病的风险,因为Desmodus rotundus在牧场区域中缺乏替代食物来源,导致更多的神经综合征病例和感染。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可以为高牧场面积地区的监测和管理策略提供信息,以减轻狂犬病传播对牲畜的风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究是观察性和回顾性的,可能会引入偏倚并限制因果推论。由于依赖现有数据且缺乏受控实验,证据强度中等。

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A geospatial, retrospective, longitudinal, observational study analyzed rabies test results for 204 cattle and 56 horses presenting with neurological syndrome in Rio de Janeiro State, Brazil, from 2020 to 2024.
analysis_en.methods: The study calculated correlations and linear models between rabies results and municipal land-use types, as well as the population of herbivores.
analysis_en.main_results: Most neurological syndrome cases and positive rabies results occurred in cattle. Larger shrub area was associated with fewer neurological syndrome reports and fewer positive results (p = 0.009 and p = 0.010, respectively). Greater cattle population showed a negative association with neurological syndrome notifications and positive detections (p = 0.085 and p = 0.046, respectively). A higher proportion of positive rabies tests was associated with larger pasture areas (p = 0.019) and with lower equine populations (p = 0.115).
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that pasture areas increase rabies risk in livestock due to the limited alternative feeding options for Desmodus rotundus, leading to more neurological syndrome cases and infections.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results can inform targeted surveillance and management strategies in regions with high pasture areas to mitigate rabies transmission risks to livestock.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is observational and retrospective, which may introduce bias and limit causal inference. The evidence is moderate due to the reliance on existing data and the absence of controlled experiments.

title_zh: 里约热内卢州牧场面积增加牲畜狂犬病风险:2020–2024年神经综合征病例的地理空间分析
source_body_en: Abstract Animal rabies poses a risk to livestock in Brazil due to transmission by hematophagous bats. The Brazilian sanitary surveillance system mandates rabies testing for any livestock exhibiting signs of neurological syndrome. This geospatial, retrospective, longitudinal, observational study analyzed rabies test results for 204 cattle and 56 horses presenting with neurological syndrome in Rio de Janeiro State, Brazil, from 2020 to 2024. We calculated correlations and linear models between rabies results and municipal land-use types, as well the population of herbivores. Most neurological syndrome cases and positive rabies results occurred in cattle. The final linear model for the number of neurological syndrome cases and positive rabies results incorporated pasture area, shrub area and cattle population. Pasture area was positively correlated with higher numbers ( p = 0.011 and p = 0.005, respectively). Larger shrub area was associated with fewer neurological syndrome reports and fewer positive results ( p = 0.009 and p = 0.010, respectively). Greater cattle population showed a negative association with neurological syndrome notifications and positive detections ( p = 0.085 and p = 0.046, respectively).A higher proportion of positive rabies tests was associated with larger pasture areas ( p = 0.019) and with lower equine populations ( p = 0.115). These findings indicate that the lower animal diversity in pasture areas provides few alternative feeding options for Desmodus rotundus besides livestock, leading to more neurological syndrome cases and animal rabies infections. A larger shrub area offer feed alternatives other than cattle to the bats and a larger cattle population dilutes the frequency of bat meals across individuals, reducing both neurological syndrome notifications and positive rabies detections.
abstract_zh: 摘要:由于血食性蝙蝠传播的传播,动物狂犬病在巴西对牲畜构成风险。巴西卫生监测系统要求对任何表现出神经综合征症状的牲畜进行狂犬病检测。本项地理空间、回顾性、纵向、观察性研究分析了2020年至2024年间巴西里约热内卢州204头牛和56匹马的神经综合征病例的狂犬病检测结果。研究计算了狂犬病检测结果与市政土地利用类型以及草食动物种群数量之间的相关性和线性模型。大多数神经综合征病例和阳性狂犬病检测结果出现在牛中。最终的线性模型将神经综合征病例数和阳性狂犬病检测结果与牧场面积、灌木面积和牛种群数量相结合。牧场面积与更高的病例数和阳性结果呈正相关(p = 0.011和p = 0.005)。更大的灌木面积与较少的神经综合征报告和较少的阳性结果相关(p = 0.009和p = 0.010)。更大的牛种群数量与神经综合征通知和阳性检测呈负相关(p = 0.085和p = 0.046)。更高的阳性狂犬病检测比例与更大的牧场面积(p = 0.019)和较低的马种群数量(p = 0.115)相关。这些发现表明,牧场区域中动物多样性较低,为Desmodus rotundus提供了极少的替代食物来源,导致更多的神经综合征病例和动物狂犬病感染。更大的灌木面积为蝙蝠提供了除牛以外的其他食物来源,而更大的牛种群数量则稀释了蝙蝠个体间的进食频率,从而减少了神经综合征报告和阳性狂犬病检测结果。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨2020年至2024年间巴西里约热内卢州牲畜狂犬病风险与土地利用模式之间的关系,因为血食性蝙蝠传播的传播对牲畜构成重大威胁。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项地理空间、回顾性、纵向、观察性研究分析了2020年至2024年间巴西里约热内卢州204头牛和56匹马的神经综合征病例的狂犬病检测结果。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究计算了狂犬病检测结果与市政土地利用类型以及草食动物种群数量之间的相关性和线性模型。
analysis_zh.main_results: 大多数神经综合征病例和阳性狂犬病检测结果出现在牛中。更大的灌木面积与较少的神经综合征报告和较少的阳性结果相关(p = 0.009和p = 0.010)。更大的牛种群数量与神经综合征通知和阳性检测呈负相关(p = 0.085和p = 0.046)。更高的阳性狂犬病检测比例与更大的牧场面积(p = 0.019)和较低的马种群数量(p = 0.115)相关。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,牧场面积增加了牲畜狂犬病的风险,因为Desmodus rotundus在牧场区域中缺乏替代食物来源,导致更多的神经综合征病例和感染。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可以为高牧场面积地区的监测和管理策略提供信息,以减轻狂犬病传播对牲畜的风险。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究是观察性和回顾性的,可能会引入偏倚并限制因果推论。由于依赖现有数据且缺乏受控实验,证据强度中等。

title: Owned dog population profile, dog ownership and bite risk determinants: Key steps to rabies control in Antananarivo, Madagascar
abstract: Rabies remains a significant public health threat in Madagascar, with dog-mediated transmission causing approximately 1,000 human deaths annually. In Antananarivo, the capital city, control efforts are hindered by limited up to date knowledge on the dog population. This study aims to provide updated estimates of the owned dog population characteristics, identify determinants of ownership, and assess dog bite incidence and risk factors to guide effective vaccination and prevention strategies. Between 2023 and 2025, a longitudinal door‐to‐door household survey was conducted across 21 fokontany (administrative units) in Antananarivo. Of 2,518 surveyed households, 30.5% reported dog ownership, with 1,273 dogs recorded, yielding an estimated dog‐to‐human ratio of 1:9. The owned dog population was predominantly male (63.6%), with a median age of three years. Survival analysis in the selected study site indicated a median lifespan of 4.4 years and an annual mortality hazard of 16%. Vaccination coverage was low: 64.2% of owned dogs had never been vaccinated, primarily due to owners’ time constraints, lack of awareness about the need for dog rabies vaccination, and financial barriers. Ownership was positively associated with household location and size, household head’s age, education and income. No significant difference in bite risk was observed between dog‐owning and non‐dog‐owning households, whereas households with children under 15 years experienced a significantly higher risk. Rabies elimination among the owned dog population in Antananarivo requires sustained, context‐adapted interventions that address high population turnover. Annual city‐wide dog vaccination campaigns combining door‐to‐door strategies with fixed‐point sites are suggested to increase the chances of reaching a larger share of the owned dog population. Public health efforts must also prioritize paediatric bite prevention and expand access to post‐exposure prophylaxis to contribute to the global goal of eliminating dog‐mediated human rabies by 2030.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 狂犬病在马达加斯加仍是一个重要的公共卫生威胁,犬传播的传播每年导致约1,000名人类死亡。在首都安塔那那利福,控制努力受到对犬只数量了解不足的阻碍。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2023年至2025年间,在安塔那那利福的21个fokontany(行政单位)中进行了纵向的入户家庭调查。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究旨在提供犬只数量特征的最新估计,识别饲养决定因素,并评估犬咬伤发病率及风险因素,以指导有效的疫苗接种和预防策略。
elements_zh.main_results: 调查了2,518户家庭,其中30.5%报告拥有犬只,共记录了1,273只犬,估计犬与人类的比例为1:9。犬只数量以雄性为主(63.6%),中位年龄为3岁。在选定的研究地点进行的生存分析表明,犬只的中位寿命为4.4年,年死亡率风险为16%。疫苗接种覆盖率较低:64.2%的犬只从未接种过疫苗,主要原因是主人时间紧张、缺乏对犬只狂犬病 疫苗接种必要性的意识以及经济障碍。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 犬只饲养与家庭位置和规模、户主年龄、教育水平和收入呈正相关。在犬只饲养家庭和非犬只饲养家庭之间未观察到咬伤风险的显著差异,而有15岁以下儿童的家庭则表现出显著更高的风险。本研究强调需要持续且适应当地情况的干预措施,以应对高犬只数量的流动性和低疫苗接种覆盖率。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 建议每年开展全市范围的犬只疫苗接种活动,结合入户策略和固定点位,以提高覆盖更多犬只数量的机会。公共卫生努力还必须优先考虑儿童咬伤预防,并扩大对暴露后预防的接触机会,以实现到2030年消除犬传播人类狂犬病的全球目标。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的发现受到低疫苗接种覆盖率和需要持续且适应当地情况的干预措施以应对高犬只数量流动性的限制。

Rabies elimination among the owned dog population in Antananarivo requires sustained, context‐adapted interventions that address high population turnover. Annual city‐wide dog vaccination campaigns combining door‐to‐door strategies with fixed‐point sites are suggested to increase the chances of reaching a larger share of the owned dog population. Public health efforts must also prioritize paediatric bite prevention and expand access to post‐exposure prophylaxis to contribute to the global goal of eliminating dog‐mediated human rabies by 2030.
abstract_zh: 狂犬病在马达加斯加仍然是一个重大的公共卫生威胁,其中通过狗传播的传播每年导致约1,000名人类死亡。在首都安塔那那利福,控制努力受到对狗种群现状了解不足的阻碍。本研究旨在提供安塔那那利福市所拥有的狗种群特征的最新估计,识别拥有狗的决定因素,并评估狗咬伤发病率及其风险因素,以指导有效的疫苗接种和预防策略。2023年至2025年间,在安塔那那利福市的21个福孔塔尼(行政单位)中开展了一项纵向的入户家庭调查。在2,518户被调查家庭中,30.5%报告拥有狗,共记录了1,273只狗,估计狗与人类的比例为1:9。所拥有的狗种群中,雄性占主导地位(63.6%),中位年龄为3岁。在选定的研究地点进行的生存分析表明,狗的中位寿命为4.4年,年死亡率危险率为16%。疫苗接种覆盖率较低:64.2%的所拥有的狗从未接种过疫苗,主要原因是主人时间紧张、缺乏对狗狂犬病 疫苗接种必要性的意识以及经济障碍。拥有狗与家庭位置、家庭规模、户主年龄、教育水平和收入呈正相关。在拥有狗和不拥有狗的家庭之间,未观察到咬伤风险的显著差异,而有15岁以下儿童的家庭则表现出显著更高的风险。为了在安塔那那利福市消除所拥有的狗种群中的狂犬病,需要持续进行适应当地情况的干预措施,以应对高人口流动性。建议开展结合入户策略与固定点位的年度全市狗疫苗接种宣传活动,以提高覆盖所拥有的狗种群的比例。公共卫生努力还必须优先考虑儿童咬伤预防,并扩大暴露后预防的可及性,以实现到2030年消除狗传播的人类狂犬病的全球目标。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 狂犬病在马达加斯加仍是一个重要的公共卫生威胁,犬传播的传播每年导致约1,000名人类死亡。在首都安塔那那利福,控制努力受到对犬只数量了解不足的阻碍。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 2023年至2025年间,在安塔那那利福的21个fokontany(行政单位)中进行了纵向的入户家庭调查。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究旨在提供犬只数量特征的最新估计,识别饲养决定因素,并评估犬咬伤发病率及风险因素,以指导有效的疫苗接种和预防策略。
analysis_zh.main_results: 调查了2,518户家庭,其中30.5%报告拥有犬只,共记录了1,273只犬,估计犬与人类的比例为1:9。犬只数量以雄性为主(63.6%),中位年龄为3岁。在选定的研究地点进行的生存分析表明,犬只的中位寿命为4.4年,年死亡率风险为16%。疫苗接种覆盖率较低:64.2%的犬只从未接种过疫苗,主要原因是主人时间紧张、缺乏对犬只狂犬病 疫苗接种必要性的意识以及经济障碍。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 犬只饲养与家庭位置和规模、户主年龄、教育水平和收入呈正相关。在犬只饲养家庭和非犬只饲养家庭之间未观察到咬伤风险的显著差异,而有15岁以下儿童的家庭则表现出显著更高的风险。本研究强调需要持续且适应当地情况的干预措施,以应对高犬只数量的流动性和低疫苗接种覆盖率。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 建议每年开展全市范围的犬只疫苗接种活动,结合入户策略和固定点位,以提高覆盖更多犬只数量的机会。公共卫生努力还必须优先考虑儿童咬伤预防,并扩大对暴露后预防的接触机会,以实现到2030年消除犬传播人类狂犬病的全球目标。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的发现受到低疫苗接种覆盖率和需要持续且适应当地情况的干预措施以应对高犬只数量流动性的限制。

abstract: Rabies is a viral zoonotic disease of warm-blooded animals, which is preventable through proper administration of post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). In controlling rabies, delays in initiating post exposure vaccination (PEV) are a challenge in endemic regions. A study was conducted to assess the delay in initiation of PEV and identify associated factors in Ethiopia. Data was collected by face-to-face interviews from 260 dog bite victims or their guardians between January and June, 2025 using a questionnaire. Post exposure vaccination was considered delayed if it was initiated after 48 hours of the exposure incident. The prevalence of delayed initiation of PEV was calculated as a percentage from the number of individuals who initiated PEV after 48 hours and the total number of individuals exposed to rabies. Factors associated with delay were identified using logistic regression models. The prevalence of delayed in initiation of rabies PEV was 86.1% (224/260); 13.9% (36/260) of participants commenced vaccination within 48 hours of exposure. Severity of bite and ownership of biting animal were factors associated with the outcome. Deep bite (OR = 0.22, 95% CI: 0.07 - 0.66, P = 0.008) and bitten by stray dogs (OR = 0.51, 95% CI = 0.27 - 0.95, P = 0.033) reduced delay in initiation of PEV. Majority of respondents (88.5%) are aware of the existence, the signs (71.5%), the way of transmission (75.4%), and the fatal nature (96.5%) of rabies, and the need for PEV (95.4%). Another majority believe that the cost of the vaccine is fair and PEV is effective (95%), and and costs of the vaccination (76.2%) was not a reason for delay. In conclusion, the study outlined that respondents know many aspects of rabies control and had fewer barriers to uptake the PEV; however, the delay in initiating PEV was high. This underscores that respondents may not be aware of the risk of delay. Therefore, interventions focusing on the risk of delayed PEV initiation are needed.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the delay in initiation of rabies post-exposure vaccination (PEV) and its associated factors among dog bite victims in Ethiopia. The research aimed to understand the challenges in rabies control in endemic regions. Data was collected through face-to-face interviews with 260 individuals between January and June 2025. The study found that 86.1% of participants experienced a delay in PEV initiation, with only 13.9% starting vaccination within 48 hours of exposure. Factors such as severity of the bite and ownership of the biting animal were linked to the delay. The findings highlight the need for interventions to address the risk of delayed PEV initiation, as awareness of the consequences of delay appears to be lacking. The study's results are based on self-reported data and do not include laboratory confirmation, which limits the strength of the evidence.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 狂犬病是一种温血动物的病毒性人兽共患病,可通过适当使用暴露后预防(暴露后预防)进行预防。在控制狂犬病的过程中,暴露后预防的启动延迟是流行病学地区的一大挑战。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项研究在埃塞俄比亚开展,旨在评估暴露后预防(PEV)的启动延迟情况,并确定相关因素。通过面对面访谈,从2025年1月至6月期间收集了260名狗咬伤受害者或其监护人的数据,使用了问卷。
elements_zh.methods: 使用逻辑回归模型确定了与延迟相关的因素。延迟开始PEV的患病率是从在暴露后48小时才开始PEV的个体数量占暴露于狂犬病的个体总数的百分比计算得出的。
elements_zh.main_results: 延迟开始狂犬病 PEV的患病率为86.1%(224/260);13.9%(36/260)的参与者在暴露后48小时内开始疫苗接种。咬伤严重程度和咬伤动物的拥有情况是与结果相关的因素。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 暴露后疫苗接种如果在暴露事件发生后48小时才开始实施,则被视为延迟的。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究指出,受访者了解许多关于狂犬病控制的方面,并且在采用PEV方面存在较少障碍;然而,启动PEV的延迟较高。这表明受访者可能不了解延迟的风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据未报告研究的局限性。由于研究基于自我报告的数据且未包括对狂犬病暴露的实验室确认,证据强度为中等。

In controlling rabies, delays in initiating post exposure vaccination (PEV) are a challenge in endemic regions.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A study was conducted to assess the delay in initiation of PEV and identify associated factors in Ethiopia. Data was collected by face-to-face interviews from 260 dog bite victims or their guardians between January and June, 2025 using a questionnaire.
analysis_en.methods: Factors associated with delay were identified using logistic regression models. The prevalence of delayed initiation of PEV was calculated as a percentage from the number of individuals who initiated PEV after 48 hours of exposure and the total number of individuals exposed to rabies.
analysis_en.main_results: The prevalence of delayed in initiation of rabies PEV was 86.1% (224/260); 13.9% (36/260) of participants commenced vaccination within 48 hours of exposure. Severity of bite and ownership of biting animal were factors associated with the outcome.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: Post exposure vaccination was considered delayed if it was initiated after 48 hours of the exposure incident.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study outlined that respondents know many aspects of rabies control and had fewer barriers to uptake the PEV; however, the delay in initiating PEV was high. This underscores that respondents may not be aware of the risk of delay.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report limitations of the study. The evidence strength is moderate as the study is based on self-reported data and does not include laboratory confirmation of rabies exposure.

title_zh: 埃博拉出血热在埃塞俄比亚贡达区狗咬伤后暴露后预防接种延迟及其影响因素的研究
source_body_en: Rabies is a viral zoonotic disease of warm-blooded animals, which is preventable through proper administration of post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). In controlling rabies, delays in initiating post exposure vaccination (PEV) are a challenge in endemic regions. A study was conducted to assess the delay in initiation of PEV and identify associated factors in Ethiopia. Data was collected by face-to-face interviews from 260 dog bite victims or their guardians between January and June, 2025 using a questionnaire. Post exposure vaccination was considered delayed if it was initiated after 48 hours of the exposure incident. The prevalence of delayed initiation of PEV was calculated as a percentage from the number of individuals who initiated PEV after 48 hours and the total number of individuals exposed to rabies. Factors associated with delay were identified using logistic regression models. The prevalence of delayed in initiation of rabies PEV was 86.1% (224/260); 13.9% (36/260) of participants commenced vaccination within 48 hours of exposure. Severity of bite and ownership of biting animal were factors associated with the outcome. Deep bite (OR = 0.22, 95% CI: 0.07 - 0.66, P = 0.008) and bitten by stray dogs (OR = 0.51, 95% CI = 0.27 - 0.95, P = 0.033) reduced delay in initiation of PEV. Majority of respondents (88.5%) are aware of the existence, the signs (71.5%), the way of transmission (75.4%), and the fatal nature (96.5%) of rabies, and the need for PEV (95.4%). Another majority believe that the cost of the vaccine is fair and PEV is effective (95%), and and costs of the vaccination (76.2%) was not a reason for delay. In conclusion, the study outlined that respondents know many aspects of rabies control and had fewer barriers to uptake the PEV; however, the delay in initiating PEV was high. This underscores that respondents may not be aware of the risk of delay. Therefore, interventions focusing on the risk of delayed PEV initiation are needed.

title: Epidemiology of Rabies Exposure and Post-Exposure Prophylaxis Among 19,239 Patients with Animal-Related Injuries in Guangxi, China: A Single-Center Retrospective Study
abstract: Rabies virus, transmitted mainly through animal bites and scratches, causes an almost invariably fatal disease. Guangxi is among the regions of China with a high rabies burden, yet large clinical datasets on exposure patterns and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) remain limited. We retrospectively analyzed the records of 19,239 patients with mammal-related injuries treated at the animal injury clinic of the International Zhuang Medicine Hospital Affiliated to Guangxi University of Chinese Medicine from 2020 to 2024. Cats (53.94%) and dogs (39.38%), predominantly owned animals, caused most injuries, and the proportion of cat-related injuries increased from 44.12% in 2020 to 56.66% in 2024 (p for trend < 0.001). Category III exposures accounted for 68.02% of cases, and repeat exposure rose from 7.81% to 18.47% (p for trend < 0.001). Overall, 32.98% of patients presented more than 24 h after injury. Standardized wound management was provided to 71.36% of patients; all patients received rabies vaccination, whereas human rabies immunoglobulin was administered in 44.86% of category III exposures and remained below 47% in every year. Delayed presentation and persistently incomplete passive immunization suggest gaps in PEP delivery. Targeted health education, animal vaccination and management, and standardized wound care and passive immunization may strengthen rabies prevention.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the need for comprehensive data on rabies exposure and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) in Guangxi, China, where rabies remains a significant public health concern. The research sought to understand exposure patterns and PEP practices among patients with animal-related injuries.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective analysis was conducted on 19,239 patients with mammal-related injuries treated at the International Zhuang Medicine Hospital Affiliated to Guangxi University of Chinese Medicine from 2020 to 2024.
analysis.methods: The study involved analyzing patient records to determine the types of injuries, exposure categories, and PEP practices. Cats and dogs were the primary sources of injuries, with a trend towards more cat-related injuries over the study period. Category III exposures and repeat exposures were also analyzed.
analysis.main_results: Cats caused the majority of injuries (53.94%), followed by dogs (39.38%). The proportion of cat-related injuries increased from 44.12% in 2020 to 56.66% in 2024 (p for trend < 0.001). Category III exposures accounted for 68.02% of cases, and repeat exposure rose from 7.81% to 18.47% (p for trend < 0.001).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlighted the increasing role of cats in rabies transmission and the need for targeted health education and improved PEP practices, particularly for category III exposures and repeat exposures.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest gaps in PEP delivery, particularly in passive immunization, and emphasize the need for standardized wound management and health education to prevent rabies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective nature and the potential for incomplete data reporting. However, the large sample size provides robust evidence for the trends observed.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed 19,239 patients with mammal-related injuries in Guangxi, China, from 2020 to 2024. It found that cats increasingly caused injuries, with a rise in category III exposures and repeat exposures. The study highlights the need for improved PEP practices and health education.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the need for comprehensive data on rabies exposure and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) in Guangxi, China, where rabies remains a significant public health concern. The research sought to understand exposure patterns and PEP practices among patients with animal-related injuries.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A retrospective analysis was conducted on 19,239 patients with mammal-related injuries treated at the International Zhuang Medicine Hospital Affiliated to Guangxi University of Chinese Medicine from 2020 to 2024.
analysis_en.methods: The study involved analyzing patient records to determine the types of injuries, exposure categories, and PEP practices. Cats and dogs were the primary sources of injuries, with a trend towards more cat-related injuries over the study period. Category III exposures and repeat exposures were also analyzed.
analysis_en.main_results: Cats caused the majority of injuries (53.94%), followed by dogs (39.38%). The proportion of cat-related injuries increased from 44.12% in 2020 to 56.66% in 2024 (p for trend < 0.001). Category III exposures accounted for 68.02% of cases, and repeat exposure rose from 7.81% to 18.47% (p for trend < 0.001).
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlighted the increasing role of cats in rabies transmission and the need for targeted health education and improved PEP practices, particularly for category III exposures and repeat exposures.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest gaps in PEP delivery, particularly in passive immunization, and emphasize the need for standardized wound management and health education to prevent rabies.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective nature and the potential for incomplete data reporting. However, the large sample size provides robust evidence for the trends observed.

title_zh: 中国广西 19,239 名动物相关伤害患者中的 流行病学 暴露和 暴露后预防:单中心回顾性研究
source_body_en: Rabies virus, transmitted mainly through animal bites and scratches, causes an almost invariably fatal disease. Guangxi is among the regions of China with a high rabies burden, yet large clinical datasets on exposure patterns and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) remain limited. We retrospectively analyzed the records of 19,239 patients with mammal-related injuries treated at the animal injury clinic of the International Zhuang Medicine Hospital Affiliated to Guangxi University of Chinese Medicine from 2020 to 2024. Cats (53.94%) and dogs (39.38%), predominantly owned animals, caused most injuries, and the proportion of cat-related injuries increased from 44.12% in 2020 to 56.66% in 2024 (p for trend < 0.001). Category III exposures accounted for 68.02% of cases, and repeat exposure rose from 7.81% to 18.47% (p for trend < 0.001). Overall, 32.98% of patients presented more than 24 h after injury. Standardized wound management was provided to 71.36% of patients; all patients received rabies vaccination, whereas human rabies immunoglobulin was administered in 44.86% of category III exposures and remained below 47% in every year. Delayed presentation and persistently incomplete passive immunization suggest gaps in PEP delivery. Targeted health education, animal vaccination and management, and standardized wound care and passive immunization may strengthen rabies prevention.

title: Case Report: Paralytic rabies masquerading as traumatic spinal cord injury: a diagnostic pitfall in trauma surgery
abstract: Rabies is a uniformly fatal zoonotic encephalitis. Its paralytic form, which accounts for approximately 20% of cases, frequently resembles acute spinal cord injury (SCI). When there is a coincident history of trauma, diagnostic anchoring may wrongly attribute neurological decline to the injury, thereby delaying the correct diagnosis. We describe the case of a 26-year-old man who developed progressive, ascending paralysis of the lower limbs 10 days after a 3-m fall. At a secondary hospital, he was clinically diagnosed with traumatic SCI without spinal MRI. On transfer, reassessment revealed a fox bite 4 months earlier and features of the hydrophobia variant (a sensation of water “entering the brain” during swallowing). Cerebrospinal fluid metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) detected Rabies lyssavirus within 48 h, showing 100% sequence identity to Chinese isolates spanning the N and L genes. This finding was subsequently confirmed by the Sichuan Provincial Center for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) using standard reference testing on peripheral blood. The patient subsequently died of autonomic and respiratory failure. This case highlights how recent trauma can obscure a fatal infectious cause. A clinical diagnosis of SCI made without neuroimaging should be regarded as provisional, and mNGS can provide an unbiased, rapid means of resolving diagnostically challenging neurological presentations.

title: A systematic review of rabies epidemiology, transmission dynamics and control from a One Health perspective in Nigeria
abstract: Rabies is a fatal viral zoonosis responsible for an estimated 20,000 human deaths annually in sub-Saharan Africa. Nigeria, Africa’s most populous nation, bears a substantial rabies burden, yet no comprehensive systematic review has synthesised evidence across human, animal, and One Health domains. We systematically searched Scopus, Web of Science, CABI, PubMed, and Google Scholar from inception to March 2026. Studies reporting rabies epidemiology, transmission, vaccination coverage, post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) utilisation, or One Health interventions in Nigeria were included. Quality assessment was performed using the OHAT Risk of Bias Tool. Narrative synthesis followed SWiM guidelines. Fifty-one studies (1981–2026) were included. Nationwide dog vaccination coverage ranged from 4.1% to 12.3% across different studies using varying methodologies and time periods, far below the WHO-recommended programme target of 70% vaccination coverage for achieving population-level protection through mass dog vaccination. Rabies positivity in submitted dog samples ranged from 1.6% to 69.1%, with significant geographic bias (72% from Plateau State). Human rabies cases were uniformly fatal (100% case fatality rate among clinically diagnosed or laboratory-confirmed rabies cases), with children aged < 15 years accounting for 46–81% of dog bite victims in studies that reported age distribution. PEP completion rates ranged from 23.4% to 95.8% across studies, with most settings reporting rates below 50%, with cost as the primary barrier. Traditional treatment use ranged from 9.6% to 91.1% across studies. Only six studies (11.8%) documented explicit One Health cross-sector collaboration, and 58% of Local Government Areas had no rabies surveillance data. Rabies remains endemic in Nigeria with persistent transmission, critically low vaccination coverage, and fragmented surveillance. Achieving the Zero by 2030 target will require urgent investment in decentralised laboratory capacity, subsidised PEP, community engagement to address traditional practices, and institutionalised One Health coordination between the human and animal health sectors.

abstract_zh: 狂犬病病毒是一种致命的病毒,据估计每年在撒哈拉以南非洲造成约20,000例人类死亡。尼日利亚作为非洲人口最多的国家,承担着显著的狂犬病病毒负担,但目前尚无全面的系统综述整合人类、动物及One Health领域的相关证据。我们系统地检索了Scopus、Web of Science、CABI、PubMed和Google Scholar数据库,时间范围从数据库建立之初至2026年3月。纳入研究包括在尼日利亚报告狂犬病病毒传播、疫苗接种覆盖率、暴露后预防(PEP)使用或One Health干预措施的相关研究。使用OHAT偏倚风险工具对研究质量进行了评估,采用SWiM指南进行了叙述性综合。共纳入51项研究(1981–2026年)。全国范围内的犬类狂犬病疫苗接种覆盖率在不同研究中差异较大,范围从4.1%到12.3%,这些研究采用不同的方法和时间范围,远低于世界卫生组织推荐的通过大规模犬类疫苗接种实现群体保护的70%覆盖率目标。提交的犬类样本中狂犬病病毒阳性率范围从1.6%到69.1%,存在显著的地理偏差(72%来自Plateau州)。人类狂犬病病例均具有致命性(在临床诊断或实验室确认的狂犬病病例中,100%的病死率),在报告年龄分布的研究中,<15岁儿童占犬咬伤受害者的46–81%。暴露后预防完成率在不同研究中范围从23.4%到95.8%,大多数地区报告的完成率低于50%,主要障碍是成本问题。传统治疗方式的使用率在不同研究中范围从9.6%到91.1%。仅有六项研究(11.8%)明确记录了One Health跨部门合作。58%的市镇行政区(Local Government Areas)没有狂犬病病毒监测数据。狂犬病病毒在尼日利亚仍为地方性流行病,存在持续传播、疫苗接种覆盖率极低以及监测体系碎片化的问题。要实现2030年零狂犬病死亡的目标,需要紧急投资于分散式实验室能力、补贴暴露后预防、开展社区参与以应对传统做法,并在人类与动物健康部门之间建立制度化的One Health协调机制。

title: Rabies surveillance in the United States during 2024
abstract: Abstract Objective Describe the epidemiologic landscape of rabies and rabies testing in the US during 2024. Methods Animal rabies testing results from approximately 130 public health, agriculture, and academic laboratories are collected by the US National Rabies Surveillance System (NRSS) each month. Data reported in 2024 were analyzed to examine temporal and geographic trends in animal rabies cases by rabies virus variant (RVV). Results In 2024, 3,834 cases of animal rabies were reported to the NRSS (4.2% of 90,343 samples submitted), representing a 2.0% increase from 2023. Of positive samples, 331 (8.6%) were domestic animals, and 3,503 (91.4%) were wildlife. The most commonly found rabid domestic animal was cats (243 positive [1.3% positivity]), and the most commonly found wildlife were bats (1,376 positive [5.7% positivity]) followed by raccoons (1,080 [10.1% positivity]). Two nonenzootic RVVs gained entry into the US in 2024. Four people died from rabies, including 2 who experienced bat exposures that were left untreated and 1 person whose case involved international travel. Conclusions The expansion of the historical range of enzootic RVVs can lead to substantial public health and animal health burden. Domestically acquired human rabies cases in 2024 underscore the need for continual public education on the risks of rabies exposures to ensure timely and effective administration of postexposure prophylaxis. The internationally acquired human rabies case demonstrates that the US remains vulnerable to human and animal rabies importations. Clinical Relevance The NRSS plays a crucial role in protecting public and animal health by monitoring rabies trends in the US.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to describe the epidemiologic landscape of rabies and rabies testing in the United States during 2024, addressing the need for understanding rabies trends and their public health implications.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed data from the US National Rabies Surveillance System (NRSS), which collects animal rabies testing results from approximately 130 public health, agriculture, and academic laboratories each month.
analysis.methods: Data reported in 2024 were analyzed to examine temporal and geographic trends in animal rabies cases by rabies virus variant (RVV), with results aggregated from the NRSS.
analysis.main_results: In 2024, 3,834 cases of animal rabies were reported to the NRSS (4.2% of 90,343 samples submitted), representing a 2.0% increase from 2023.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the increasing prevalence of animal rabies in the US, with a notable rise in cases compared to the previous year.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results emphasize the importance of ongoing rabies surveillance and public education to mitigate the risks of rabies exposure and ensure timely postexposure prophylaxis.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to data collected by the NRSS, which may not capture all rabies cases, and the evidence is based on reported data, which could be subject to underreporting or variability in testing practices.

analysis.summary_en: This study provides an overview of rabies surveillance in the United States during 2024, highlighting the epidemiologic landscape and trends in animal rabies cases. The National Rabies Surveillance System (NRSS) collected data from approximately 130 laboratories, reporting 3,834 rabies cases from 90,343 samples, a 2.0% increase from 2023. The most common rabid domestic animals were cats, and the most common wildlife were bats and raccoons. The study underscores the need for public education on rabies risks to ensure timely postexposure prophylaxis, as four human deaths were reported, including two from untreated bat exposures and one from an international travel-related case. The findings suggest that the expansion of enzootic rabies virus variants poses a public health and animal health burden, emphasizing the role of the NRSS in monitoring rabies trends. However, the study is limited to data from the NRSS, which may not fully represent all rabies cases due to potential underreporting or testing inconsistencies.

title: Serological response to extralabel use of parenteral rabies vaccines in 28 mammalian species
abstract: Abstract Objective To evaluate immunogenicity, persistence of antibodies, survival after challenge, and anamnestic response following extralabel parenteral rabies vaccination across mammalian species compared with benchmarks from on-label canine vaccination. Methods Mammals described in published studies of extralabel parenteral rabies vaccination. A structured literature review (1980 to 2025) identified studies reporting serologic or challenge outcomes after extralabel parenteral rabies vaccination. Extracted data included taxonomic family; vaccine type and schedule, timing of serum collection, antibody titers, survival after experimental challenge, and response to booster vaccination. Random-effects meta-analyses were conducted by family and overall. Pooled proportions were compared with the World Organisation for Animal Health benchmark of 88% survival and with canine benchmarks for primary seroconversion (88.1%), antibody levels 6 to 12 months after primary vaccination (72.9%), and booster response (96.8%). Results 32 articles describing 41 studies met inclusion criteria, representing 2,630 animals from 28 species in 17 families. After primary vaccination, 84.4 ± 4.1% achieved titers ≥ 0.5 IU/mL, with 14 of 16 families noninferior to the canine benchmark. At ≥ 6 months, 63.7 ± 10.6% maintained titers ≥ 0.5 IU/mL. Among 79 vaccinated animals challenged with rabies virus, 89.0 ± 9.8% survived. Booster vaccination produced adequate titers in 89.1 ± 8.0% of 275 animals, with reduced responses in the families Elephantidae and Ursidae. Conclusions Modern-day rabies vaccines generate strong antibody responses across diverse mammalian families, with nondomestic canids responding similarly to domestic dogs. Clinical Relevance These findings support recognizing extralabel vaccination as biologically protective and can inform public health and animal management policies.
journal: Journal of the American Veterinary Medical Association

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述评估了哺乳动物物种中标签外注射 狂犬病 疫苗接种 后的免疫原性、抗体的持久性、攻击后的存活率以及记忆反应,并与标签上的犬类 疫苗接种 的基准进行了比较。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 一项结构化文献综述(1980 年至 2025 年)确定了报告标签外注射 狂犬病 疫苗接种 后血清学或挑战结果的研究。提取的数据包括分类科;疫苗 类型和时间表、血清采集时间、抗体滴度、实验攻击后的存活率以及对加强剂 疫苗接种 的反应。按家庭和整体进行随机效应荟萃分析。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 初次 疫苗接种 后,84.4 ± 4.1% 的家系达到滴度 ≥ 0.5 IU/mL,其中 16 个家系中有 14 个家系不劣于犬类基准。≥ 6 个月时,63.7 ± 10.6% 的滴度维持≥ 0.5 IU/mL。在接受 狂犬病病毒 攻击的 79 只接种疫苗的动物中,89.0 ± 9.8% 存活。加强剂 疫苗接种 在 275 只动物中的 89.1 ± 8.0% 中产生了足够的滴度,但象科和熊科的反应有所降低。现代 狂犬病 疫苗 在不同的哺乳动物家族中产生强烈的抗体反应,非家养犬科动物的反应与家养狗类似。

title_zh: 28 种哺乳动物对肠外注射 狂犬病 疫苗 的标签外使用的血清学反应
source_body_en: Abstract Objective To evaluate immunogenicity, persistence of antibodies, survival after challenge, and anamnestic response following extralabel parenteral rabies vaccination across mammalian species compared with benchmarks from on-label canine vaccination. Methods Mammals described in published studies of extralabel parenteral rabies vaccination. A structured literature review (1980 to 2025) identified studies reporting serologic or challenge outcomes after extralabel parenteral rabies vaccination. Extracted data included taxonomic family; vaccine type and schedule, timing of serum collection, antibody titers, survival after experimental challenge, and response to booster vaccination. Random-effects meta-analyses were conducted by family and overall. Pooled proportions were compared with the World Organisation for Animal Health benchmark of 88% survival and with canine benchmarks for primary seroconversion (88.1%), antibody levels 6 to 12 months after primary vaccination (72.9%), and booster response (96.8%). Results 32 articles describing 41 studies met inclusion criteria, representing 2,630 animals from 28 species in 17 families. After primary vaccination, 84.4 ± 4.1% achieved titers ≥ 0.5 IU/mL, with 14 of 16 families noninferior to the canine benchmark. At ≥ 6 months, 63.7 ± 10.6% maintained titers ≥ 0.5 IU/mL. Among 79 vaccinated animals challenged with rabies virus, 89.0 ± 9.8% survived. Booster vaccination produced adequate titers in 89.1 ± 8.0% of 275 animals, with reduced responses in the families Elephantidae and Ursidae. Conclusions Modern-day rabies vaccines generate strong antibody responses across diverse mammalian families, with nondomestic canids responding similarly to domestic dogs. Clinical Relevance These findings support recognizing extralabel vaccination as biologically protective and can inform public health and animal management policies.
abstract_zh: 摘要 目的 与标签犬类 狂犬病 疫苗接种 的基准相比,评估哺乳动物物种中标签外注射 狂犬病 疫苗接种 的免疫原性、抗体持久性、攻击后存活率和记忆反应。方法 已发表的标签外注射 狂犬病 疫苗接种 研究中描述的哺乳动物。一项结构化文献综述(1980 年至 2025 年)确定了报告标签外注射 狂犬病 疫苗接种 后血清学或挑战结果的研究。提取的数据包括分类科;疫苗 类型和时间表、血清采集时间、抗体滴度、实验攻击后的存活率以及对加强剂 疫苗接种 的反应。按家庭和整体进行随机效应荟萃分析。汇总比例与世界动物健康组织 88% 存活率基准以及犬类初次血清转化基准 (88.1%)、初次 疫苗接种 后 6 至 12 个月的抗体水平 (72.9%) 和加强反应 (96.8%) 进行比较。结果 描述 41 项研究的 32 篇文章符合纳入标准,代表 17 个科 28 个物种的 2,630 只动物。初次 疫苗接种 后,84.4 ± 4.1% 的家系达到滴度 ≥ 0.5 IU/mL,其中 16 个家系中有 14 个家系不劣于犬类基准。≥ 6 个月时,63.7 ± 10.6% 的滴度维持≥ 0.5 IU/mL。在接受 狂犬病病毒 攻击的 79 只接种疫苗的动物中,89.0 ± 9.8% 存活。加强剂 疫苗接种 在 275 只动物中的 89.1 ± 8.0% 中产生了足够的滴度,但象科和熊科的反应有所降低。结论 现代 狂犬病 疫苗 在不同的哺乳动物家族中产生强烈的抗体反应,非家养犬科动物的反应与家养狗类似。临床相关性 这些发现支持将额外标签 疫苗接种 视为生物保护性的,并可为公共卫生和动物管理政策提供信息。

title: RAIVA NO BRASIL: Características gerais e os desafios na prevenção RABIES IN BRAZIL: General characteristics and challenges in prevention RABIA EN BRASIL: Características generales y desafíos en la prevención
abstract: Este trabalho aborda o tema dos desafios no controle da raiva no Brasil, uma zoonose viral de elevada letalidade que acomete mamíferos e permanece como importante problema de saúde pública e animal, apesar de ser uma doença prevenível. A escolha desse tema se justifica pela permanência da circulação do vírus em diferentes regiões brasileiras e pela ocorrência de casos envolvendo animais domésticos, de produção e silvestres, demonstrando a necessidade de manutenção das ações de vigilância e prevenção. A importância deste estudo reside na necessidade de compreender os fatores que favorecem a persistência da doença, especialmente aqueles relacionados à vacinação, à vigilância epidemiológica, ao diagnóstico e à participação de diferentes reservatórios animais. Objetivou-se, portanto, analisar os principais desafios relacionados ao controle da raiva no Brasil, identificando os fatores associados à sua persistência e à circulação das diferentes variantes virais. A metodologia utilizada foi uma pesquisa qualitativa, exploratória, desenvolvida por meio de revisão bibliográfica narrativa, com análise de artigos científicos, documentos oficiais, teses, dissertações e dados epidemiológicos. Como resultado, observou-se redução expressiva dos casos de raiva canina ao longo dos anos, mas também a permanência da circulação viral associada principalmente a reservatórios silvestres. Conclui-se que o controle da doença depende da continuidade da vacinação, da vigilância epidemiológica e da integração entre saúde humana, animal e ambiental.

analysis.methods: A qualitative, exploratory research methodology was employed, based on a narrative literature review. This involved the analysis of scientific articles, official documents, theses, dissertations, and epidemiological data to understand the factors influencing rabies persistence and circulation.
analysis.main_results: The study observed a significant reduction in canine rabies cases over the years, but also noted the continued presence of the virus primarily associated with wild animal reservoirs.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that rabies control in Brazil relies on the continuity of vaccination programs, epidemiological surveillance, and the integration of human, animal, and environmental health efforts. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the need for sustained vaccination and surveillance strategies, particularly in addressing the role of wild animal reservoirs in maintaining rabies circulation. analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a narrative literature review, which may introduce bias and limit the depth of analysis. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the reliance on secondary sources rather than primary data collection.

The study's findings contribute to understanding the ongoing challenges in rabies prevention and suggest the necessity of a multifaceted approach. However, the reliance on secondary sources limits the strength of the evidence, and the conclusions are based on qualitative analysis rather than quantitative data.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在巴西进行,重点关注 狂犬病病毒 在不同地区的持续传播及其与家养动物、生产动物和野生动物的关联。其目的是分析该国与 狂犬病 控制相关的主要挑战,确定导致该疾病持续存在和不同病毒变种传播的因素。
elements_zh.methods: 采用基于叙述性文献综述的定性、探索性研究方法。这涉及对科学文章、官方文件、论文、论文和流行病学数据的分析,以了解影响 狂犬病 持续存在和传播的因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究观察到多年来犬类 狂犬病 病例显着减少,但也注意到主要与野生动物 储存宿主 有关的病毒持续存在。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明需要持续的 疫苗接种 和 监测 策略,特别是在解决野生动物 储存宿主 在维持 狂犬病 循环中的作用方面。他们还强调了人类、动物和环境卫生部门采取综合方法的重要性。

title_zh: RAIVA NO BRASIL:巴西的特征和预防措施 狂犬病:预防的一般特征和挑战 RABIA EN BRASIL:一般特征和预防措施
source_body_en: Este trabalho aborda o tema dos desafios no controle da raiva no Brasil, uma zoonose viral de elevada letalidade que acomete mamíferos e permanece como importante problema de saúde pública e animal, apesar de ser uma doença prevenível. A escolha desse tema se justifica pela permanência da circulação do vírus em diferentes regiões brasileiras e pela ocorrência de casos envolvendo animais domésticos, de produção e silvestres, demonstrando a necessidade de manutenção das ações de vigilância e prevenção. A importância deste estudo reside na necessidade de compreender os fatores que favorecem a persistência da doença, especialmente aqueles relacionados à vacinação, à vigilância epidemiológica, ao diagnóstico e à participação de diferentes reservatórios animais. Objetivou-se, portanto, analisar os principais desafios relacionados ao controle da raiva no Brasil, identificando os fatores associados à sua persistência e à circulação das diferentes variantes virais. A metodologia utilizada foi uma pesquisa qualitativa, exploratória, desenvolvida por meio de revisão bibliográfica narrativa, com análise de artigos científicos, documentos oficiais, teses, dissertações e dados epidemiológicos. Como resultado, observou-se redução expressiva dos casos de raiva canina ao longo dos anos, mas também a permanência da circulação viral associada principalmente a reservatórios silvestres. Conclui-se que o controle da doença depende da continuidade da vacinação, da vigilância epidemiológica e da integração entre saúde humana, animal e ambiental.

title: Microbiological safety assessment of canine adipose derived mesenchymal stem cell preparations reveal no detectable contamination
abstract: The experimental application of canine adipose-derived mesenchymal stem/stromal cells (cAD-MSC) has demonstrated excellent therapeutic potential in the treatment of a number of previously untreatable or difficult-to-treat diseases. However, the production of cAD-MSC for clinical application necessitates in vitro isolation and cell expansion, introducing the risk of microbiological contamination. Studies indicate that stored MSCs may be contaminated with bacteria, fungi, or viruses, resulting in cell transformation, cell death, or persistent infection. This ultimately compromises therapeutic efficacy and potentially facilitates therapy-induced pathogen transmission. In accordance with the European Medicines Agency guidelines mandating sterility testing as an integral component of the manufacturing process, this study aimed to assess the sterility of the cAD-MSC bank at the Croatian Veterinary Institute. To test for the most clinically significant canine pathogens, nucleic acids were extracted from 32 cAD-MSC preparations and analyzed using standard molecular PCR methods. The pathogen screening panel included rabies virus (Lyssavirus), canine herpesvirus (Varicellovirus canidalpha1), parvovirus (Carnivore protoparvovirus 1), coronavirus (Alphacoronavirus 1), distemper virus (Morbillivirus canis), Rotavirus A, Leptospira spp, Brucella canis, Borrelia burgdorferi sensu lato, Anaplasma spp, Ehrlichia spp, Mycoplasma spp (hemotropic), and Neospora caninum. No tested gene fragments of the aforementioned pathogens were detected, indicating that the cAD-MSC preparations were free from the presence of clinically significant pathogens. Rigorous implementation of sterility control during the cell isolation and expansion process is essential to ensure safe cell-based therapy in canine patients.

source_records.abstract: The experimental application of canine adipose-derived mesenchymal stem/stromal cells (cAD-MSC) has demonstrated excellent therapeutic potential in the treatment of a number of previously untreatable or difficult-to-treat diseases. However, the production of cAD-MSC for clinical application necessitates in vitro isolation and cell expansion, introducing the risk of microbiological contamination. Studies indicate that stored MSCs may be contaminated with bacteria, fungi, or viruses, resulting in cell transformation, cell death, or persistent infection. This ultimately compromises therapeutic efficacy and potentially facilitates therapy-induced pathogen transmission. In accordance with the European Medicines Agency guidelines mandating sterility testing as an integral component of the manufacturing process, this study aimed to assess the sterility of the cAD-MSC bank at the Croatian Veterinary Institute. No tested gene fragments of the aforementioned pathogens were detected, indicating that the cAD-MSC preparations were free from the presence of clinically significant pathogens. Rigorous implementation of sterility control during the cell isolation and expansion process is essential to ensure safe cell-based therapy in canine patients.

abstract_zh: 犬脂肪源性间充质干细胞/基质细胞(cAD-MSC)的实验应用已证明治疗对许多以前无法治疗或难以治疗的疾病具有优异的治疗潜力。然而,用于临床应用的cAD-MSC的生产需要体外分离和细胞扩增,从而引入微生物污染的风险。研究表明,储存的间充质干细胞可能被细菌、真菌或病毒污染,导致细胞转化、细胞死亡或持续感染。这最终会损害治疗效果并可能促进治疗诱导的病原体 传播。根据欧洲药品管理局指南,要求将无菌检测作为生产过程的一个组成部分,本研究旨在评估克罗地亚兽医研究所 cAD-MSC 库的无菌性。为了检测临床上最重要的犬病原体,从 32 个 cAD-MSC 制剂中提取核酸,并使用标准分子 PCR 方法进行分析。病原体筛查小组包括狂犬病病毒(狂犬病毒)、犬疱疹病毒(Varicellovirus canidalpha1)、细小病毒(Carnivore protoparvovirus 1)、冠状病毒(Alphacoronavirus 1)、犬瘟热病毒(Morbillivirus canis)、轮状病毒A、钩端螺旋体属、犬布鲁氏菌、伯氏疏螺旋体、无形体spp、埃利希体属、支原体属(嗜血性)和犬新孢子虫。没有检测到上述病原体的测试基因片段,表明cAD-MSC制剂不存在临床上显着的病原体。在细胞分离和扩增过程中严格实施无菌控制对于确保犬类患者的安全细胞治疗至关重要。

title: Peer Review Report For: Development and Characterization of Pseudotype-based Microneutralization Assay to Assess Functionality of Anti-rabies Protein G Antibodies [version 2; peer review: 1 approved, 1 approved with reservations]
abstract: Background Rabies virus (RABV) is a neurotropic zoonotic pathogen responsible for an estimated 60,000 human deaths annually. Despite widespread vaccination programs, rabies remains a substantial public health burden, particularly in regions with limited access to post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). Standard serological assays for evaluating rabies vaccine immunogenicity, including the Rapid Fluorescent Focus Inhibition Test (RFFIT) and the Fluorescent Antibody Virus Neutralization (FAVN) test, require live virus handling under biosafety level 3 (BSL-3) conditions, limiting their scalability and broader implementation. Methods We developed and characterized a pseudotype-based microneutralization assay using a lentiviral HIV-1 backbone to generate pseudotyped viral particles expressing glycoproteins from three antigenically distinct rabies virus strains: CTN-1 V5, CVS-11, and Pasteur. Neutralization assays were performed under BSL-2 conditions, and assay performance was evaluated in terms of sensitivity, specificity, and suitability for high-throughput applications. Results The pseudotype-based assay enabled sensitive and reproducible detection of rabies virus–neutralizing antibodies across the three glycoprotein variants. The platform demonstrated robust performance under BSL-2 containment, supporting efficient and scalable testing. Inclusion of antigenically distinct strains broadened detection capacity and improved the assessment of strain-specific neutralizing responses. Conclusions This pseudotype-based microneutralization assay represents a safe, flexible, and scalable alternative to conventional live-virus neutralization tests. By enabling high-throughput rabies serology under BSL-2 conditions, this platform supports vaccine evaluation and seroepidemiological surveillance, particularly in settings where BSL-3 infrastructure is limited.

abstract_zh: 背景 狂犬病病毒 (RABV) 是一种嗜神经性人畜共患病原体,每年估计导致 60,000 人死亡。尽管 疫苗接种 计划广泛传播,但 狂犬病 仍然是巨大的公共卫生负担,特别是在 暴露后预防 (PEP) 获取机会有限的地区。用于评估 狂犬病 疫苗 免疫原性的标准血清学测定,包括快速荧光聚焦抑制试验 (RFFIT) 和荧光抗体病毒中和 (FAVN) 试验,需要在生物安全 3 级 (BSL-3) 条件下处理活病毒,限制了其可扩展性和更广泛的实施。方法我们开发并表征了一种基于假型的微中和测定,使用慢病毒 HIV-1 主链生成表达来自三种抗原不同的 狂犬病病毒 菌株(CTN-1 V5、CVS-11 和巴斯德)的糖蛋白的假型病毒颗粒。中和测定在 BSL-2 条件下进行,并从灵敏度、特异性和高通量应用的适用性方面评估测定性能。结果基于假型的测定能够灵敏且可重复地检测三种糖蛋白变体的 狂犬病病毒 中和抗体。该平台在 BSL-2 遏制下表现出强大的性能,支持高效且可扩展的测试。包含抗原性不同的菌株扩大了检测能力并改进了菌株特异性中和反应的评估。结论 这种基于假型的微量中和试验是传统活病毒中和试验的一种安全、灵活且可扩展的替代方法。通过在 BSL-2 条件下启用高通量 狂犬病 血清学,该平台支持 疫苗 评估和血清流行病学 监测,特别是在 BSL-3 基础设施有限的环境中。

title: Managing Potential Australian Bat Lyssavirus (ABLV) Exposure in Regional Queensland: A Mixed-Methods Investigation of Epidemiology and Operational Challenges
abstract: Background/Objectives: Australian bat lyssavirus (ABLV) is a rare but fatal zoonotic infection transmitted from infected bats. In Queensland, Australia, all potential human exposures should be reported to local public health units for assessment and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). Following a marked increase in notifications in 2025, the Darling Downs Public Health Unit (DDPHU), serving the Darling Downs and South West regions of Queensland, evaluated the epidemiology and operational challenges using a retrospective mixed-methods design. Methods: Data of all potential ABLV exposure notifications within the DDPHU catchment between 2011 and 2025 were collected from existing databases to describe demographic, temporal, spatial, and case management outcomes. Staff meeting records were analysed using framework analysis to identify operational challenges. Results: There were 237 potential exposure notifications, with annual counts fluctuating and peaks noted in 2013 and 2025. Notifications showed a seasonal pattern, peaking in spring and summer. Demographic characteristics of cases remained similar over time. Exposures were concentrated in the eastern part of the catchment, with no significant spatio-temporal clustering. Intentional contact with bats remained the leading cause of exposure. Over the study period, the proportion with documented PEP completion increased, as did timeliness of notification and PEP initiation. However, staff management time per case increased. Key operational challenges included the time-critical nature of case management, atypical exposure scenarios, and logistical complexity in arranging PEP across multiple providers. Availability of pre-positioned PEP at selected hospitals was perceived by staff to reduce workload. Conclusions: Although potential exposures aligned with known bat distribution and seasonal activity, the 2025 surge resulted in greater workload. Measures, including improved public health messaging, expanded pre-positioned PEP, and local protocols for atypical scenarios, may optimise case management and support workforce sustainability. These findings also highlighted the importance of accessible PEP and effective service coordination for timely management of potential lyssavirus exposures in non-urban settings.

title: High rabies mortality and barriers to effective management in Tigray during prolonged war and deadly siege
abstract: Global efforts has been undertaken to eliminate dog mediated human rabies deaths by 2030. This target was proposed to undertake various prevention and control measures including the integrated surveillance system and optimal dog vaccination. However, the impact of a collapsed healthcare system during the prolonged war and siege in Tigray, Ethiopia, remains poorly understood on the status of the surveillance system, and the burden of rabies. Therefore, this study assessed clinical rabies mortality patterns and explored challenges in rabies prevention and control methods. A mixed method approach with retrospective analysis of surveillance data (2017–2023) and in-depth interviews with human health and animal health experts were conducted in Tigray region of the Northern Ethiopia. Surveillance data from 2017 to 2023 were analyzed across the pre-war period (2017–2019), the transition year in which the war began in November (2020), the wartime period (2021–2022), and the early post-war recovery period (2023), when health and surveillance services had not yet been fully restored. Data were analysed using MS Excel and Arc GIS, while qualitative data were thematically examined. During the pre-war period (2017–2019), 8384 suspected rabies exposures and eight clinical rabies deaths were reported. In the 2020 transition year, 1881 exposures and two deaths were reported. During the wartime period (2021–2022), reported exposures declined to 501 while 49 deaths were recorded. In the early post-war recovery period (2023), 1481 exposures and 20 deaths were reported. Rabies deaths were notably higher in Central, North-western, and Southern zone of Tigray during the war while reporting completeness declined to below 12% in 2021. Qualitative data revealed significant disruption of rabies control were identified such as, decreased health-seeking behaviour, disruption of rabies prevention and control measures, and weak coordination among the One Health sectors. Reported clinical rabies deaths increased markedly during the wartime period and remained elevated during early post-war recovery, when healthcare, surveillance, PEP provision, and rabies-control services had not yet been fully restored. Strengthening surveillance, restoring PEP access, and enhancing One Health collaboration are essential.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 然而,在埃塞俄比亚提格雷的长期战争和围困期间,医疗系统崩溃所造成的影响对于 监测 系统的状况以及 狂犬病 的负担仍然知之甚少。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 因此,本研究评估了临床狂犬病 死亡率模式,并探讨了狂犬病预防和控制方法中的挑战。
elements_zh.methods: 在埃塞俄比亚北部的提格雷地区进行了混合方法,对 监测 数据(2017-2023 年)进行回顾性分析,并对人类健康和动物健康专家进行深入访谈。
elements_zh.main_results: 定性数据显示,狂犬病 控制受到严重破坏,例如寻求健康行为减少、狂犬病 预防和控制措施受到破坏以及“同一个健康”部门之间的协调薄弱。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在战后恢复初期(2023 年),报告了 1,481 例暴露事件和 20 例死亡。

title_zh: 高 狂犬病 死亡率 和长期战争和致命围困期间提格雷有效管理的障碍
source_body_en: Global efforts has been undertaken to eliminate dog mediated human rabies deaths by 2030. This target was proposed to undertake various prevention and control measures including the integrated surveillance system and optimal dog vaccination. However, the impact of a collapsed healthcare system during the prolonged war and siege in Tigray, Ethiopia, remains poorly understood on the status of the surveillance system, and the burden of rabies. Therefore, this study assessed clinical rabies mortality patterns and explored challenges in rabies prevention and control methods. A mixed method approach with retrospective analysis of surveillance data (2017–2023) and in-depth interviews with human health and animal health experts were conducted in Tigray region of the Northern Ethiopia. Surveillance data from 2017 to 2023 were analyzed across the pre-war period (2017–2019), the transition year in which the war began in November (2020), the wartime period (2021–2022), and the early post-war recovery period (2023), when health and surveillance services had not yet been fully restored. Data were analysed using MS Excel and Arc GIS, while qualitative data were thematically examined. During the pre-war period (2017–2019), 8384 suspected rabies exposures and eight clinical rabies deaths were reported. In the 2020 transition year, 1881 exposures and two deaths were reported. During the wartime period (2021–2022), reported exposures declined to 501 while 49 deaths were recorded. In the early post-war recovery period (2023), 1481 exposures and 20 deaths were reported. Rabies deaths were notably higher in Central, North-western, and Southern zone of Tigray during the war while reporting completeness declined to below 12% in 2021. Qualitative data revealed significant disruption of rabies control were identified such as, decreased health-seeking behaviour, disruption of rabies prevention and control measures, and weak coordination among the One Health sectors. Reported clinical rabies deaths increased markedly during the wartime period and remained elevated during early post-war recovery, when healthcare, surveillance, PEP provision, and rabies-control services had not yet been fully restored. Strengthening surveillance, restoring PEP access, and enhancing One Health collaboration are essential.
